newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Water to dispose of Applied unit.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Water to dispose of Applied unit.

text.p: Consumers Water Co said on Tuesday it plans to dispose of its Consumers Applied Technologies Inc (CAT) unit, an unregulated subsidiary.
Consumers said CAT, a technical services company with offices in Connecticut and Florida, recently completed a reorganization but failed to meet its parent's performance criteria.
Consumers said CAT had a first-quarter operating loss of $387,000. Consumers also took a first-quarter charge of $1.5 million to cover anticipated costs of disposing of the unit.
CAT will be sold, either as a whole or in pieces, or shut down if no buyers are found, the company said.
Consumers Water reported operating net income per share of $0.21 for the first quarter, compared to $0.22 for the same period the year before.
Consumers Water provides water and wastewater services to 228,000 customers though eight operating companies in the Midwest and the Northeast.
